Class ScenarioGridInitializer

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.core.ScenarioGridInitializer
public final class ScenarioGridInitializer extends Object

ScenarioGridInitializer

Single unified headless pipeline constructing H3 hexagonal scenario meshes identically for both CLI/Headless batch execution and JavaFX GUI launch.

Unified Two-Stage Geospatial Pipeline

  1. Geometry & Windowing: Constructs pure H3 cellular topology via H3Service (full globe or regional bounding box), tagging clipped perimeter boundary cells.
  2. 2048×1024 Raster Resolution & Spherical H3 Aggregation: Resolves authoritative $2048 \times 1024$ rasters (empirical ETOPO/WorldClim/planetary archives, custom imported Base64 rasters, or upstream procedural Simplex noise rasters when no imported maps exist), then aggregates every raster uniformly onto the H3 mesh via H3RasterAggregator and computes hydrography flow.
